argument:
Meta’s comparable revenue growth demonstrates that advertising demand remains strong. The official legal-charge bridge identifies a large non-recurring expense, showing why reported operating-margin contraction should not automatically be extrapolated as a permanent loss of core earning power.

Inference: investment could support future monetization if returns materialize. Improving price momentum near SMA200 offers a possible confirmation route. Planned financing and negative FCF warrant restraint, but proposed issuance is not identical to completed dilution and does not by itself prove operating demand has collapsed. No authenticated valuation discount is claimed.
key_points: Identified legal charge distinguishes reported from underlying operations
Improving momentum provides a conditional confirmation route
